about: Regression cases from the user's own live recordings (extractor/recordings/live-20260926-<session>/session.wav, private, never copied). Ground truth confirmed by the user on 2026-09-26. Times are the event span as recorded (ms from the session start); a case matches the replayed event that overlaps it most. tests/test_live_cases.py skips a case whose WAV is missing.

cases.what: whistle arch: short early rise (~1.3 st), longer fall (~6 st)
cases.why_open: open: asymmetric whistle arch (small early rise, bigger fall); by the extractor's rule (hump >= |net|) and the wiki's (peak >= 4 st above both ends) it is a fall. arch_ratio 0.5 fixes 1 of 4 and flips other live contours; see the extractor README 'Known weaknesses'. Per-user: enroll a gesture arch.
